turns.customer: My Glowworm 150 headlamp (order #1302) never showed up and the tracking hasn't changed in ages. Can I get my money back?
turns.reply:
I'm sorry about the hassle — the package was confirmed lost by the carrier (Parcelway declared it lost on Sept 5).

Good news: your full refund of **$27.98** has been issued to your original payment method. That covers the headlamp ($19.99) plus shipping ($7.99).

Thanks for your patience while this fell through the cracks on the carrier's end.
